summary: Prod metrics missing required labels (route/model/region/tier) for rollout SLO monitor identity contract
description:
Requester: Allison (Observability standards)

Context
Auto-rollback on SLO breach work depends on being able to reliably query latency/error SLOs using a canonical monitor identity (ADR-0147). Current production request metrics are missing/incorrect labels for several high-traffic routes, which prevents generating monitors with stable identities and causes monitor queries to aggregate across unrelated traffic.

Issue summary
The following required dimensions are missing or inconsistently populated on the request latency/error metrics emitted by api-gateway and serving edge:
- route / route_id (sometimes blank, sometimes only path template, sometimes full path)
- model (missing for embeddings + rerank in some codepaths)
- model_version (missing for pinned-version requests routed through legacy fallback)
- customer_tier (not present on some Dedicated ingress; shows as "unknown")
- region (present on most metrics, but absent on a subset of us-east gateway pods due to exporter config)

Why this matters / impact
- Blocks monitor creation/migration under ADR-0147 and the rollout-controller SLO integration (auto-rollback can’t evaluate per route/model/region/tier accurately).
- Creates false positives/false negatives when monitors aggregate mixed traffic.
- SRE cannot confidently tune thresholds without correct segmentation.

Observed symptoms
- In dashboards, p95 latency panels show route="" for a subset of traffic.
- Error rate monitors cannot filter by model_version for canary traffic.

Expected label set (minimum for monitor identity)
- service
- env
- region
- route_id (or canonical route)
- model
- model_version
- customer_tier
- deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated/private) where applicable

Steps to reproduce
1) In Grafana/Explore, query request latency metric for api-gateway in prod.
2) Group by route_id and model_version.
3) Note large portion of samples have route_id="" and/or model_version="".

Acceptance criteria
- For api-gateway and serving-edge exported metrics in prod, required labels above are present and conform to normalization rules in ADR-0147.
- route_id uses canonical route template (not raw path) and is stable across releases.
- customer_tier resolves correctly for Dedicated ingress.
- Add a lightweight validation dashboard/panel that shows percentage of samples missing each required label (per region).

Notes / constraints
- We do not need historical backfill; forward correctness is sufficient for monitor migration.
- Be mindful of cardinality: route_id must be a template / internal ID, not raw URL.
comments: 2025-01-29 10:14 Allison Grant (Reporter): Flagging as P1 dependency for auto-rollback. We can’t finalize monitor templates until route/model/model_version labels are consistent. Seeing route_id empty for ~18–25% of api-gateway samples in us-east over last 24h. Linked ADR-0147 for canonical identity expectations.

2025-01-29 12:03 Caleb Johnson (Assignee): Acknowledged. Initial hypothesis: route label is set in gateway middleware but not executed for streaming + some legacy endpoints (embeddings/rerank). Also noticing one cluster has an older otel-collector config that drops resource attrs (region). Will dig into exporter + collector transforms.

2025-01-30 09:27 Logan Wright: +1 this is blocking the monitor labeling migration (ENG-2322). Please ensure whatever we do doesn’t increase cardinality (no raw path). If we need a new canonical field, prefer route_template_id from router.

2025-01-30 14:58 Caleb Johnson: Found two issues:
(1) api-gateway: route_id label only set for the "chat" router chain. The embeddings + rerank handlers bypass the route labeling middleware. Fix: move label assignment earlier (shared request context) and use router’s canonical template ID.
(2) otel-collector in prod/us-east-b has a stale config missing the resource attribute processor that maps k8s.node.region -> region. This is why region is absent for subset of pods.
Working on patch + rollout plan with Release Eng.

2025-01-31 11:41 Benji Okafor: For rollout-controller queries we also need model_version for canary/stable split. Do we have that in gateway context for legacy pinned routes? We’ve seen model_version="" when fallback is used.

2025-01-31 13:10 Caleb Johnson: model_version missing comes from requests that are resolved downstream and not reflected back to gateway metrics. Proposed fix: gateway should emit both requested_model (as sent) and resolved_model_version (as routed) from the routing response headers. Mina confirmed routing layer already returns X-Redwood-Resolved-Model + version; we just weren’t plucking it into metric labels. Implementing resolved_model_version label populated when present; otherwise "unknown" (explicit).

2025-02-03 09:02 Connor O'Brien: Please coordinate deployment with feature flags. If this changes metric label keys, we need to ensure dashboards/alerts don’t break. If possible, add new labels while keeping old ones for 1–2 weeks (dual-write).

2025-02-03 16:35 Caleb Johnson: Plan:
- Dual-write for 14 days: keep existing route label ("route") and add canonical "route_id".
- Add "resolved_model_version" label in addition to existing "model_version" (which was request-side).
- Collector config update in us-east-b to restore region mapping.
- Add a validation panel to rollout SLO dashboard: %missing(route_id), %missing(resolved_model_version), %missing(customer_tier), per region.
Target rollout: start 2025-02-04 AM, complete by EOD.

2025-02-04 18:12 Caleb Johnson: Deployed gateway change to 25% in us-east + eu-west. Early results: route_id missing dropped from ~22% -> <1% in canary. resolved_model_version now present for ~96% of samples; remaining are true unknowns where routing response header isn’t returned (investigating a small set of internal health endpoints; may exclude from SLO monitors anyway).

2025-02-05 12:26 Allison Grant: Confirmed Grafana explore looks much better; can now group by route_id/model/resolved_model_version and see clean segmentation. Remaining missing values appear limited to healthz/metrics endpoints. Please ensure those are excluded from monitor templates (we already exclude them in SLO definitions doc).

2025-02-06 09:40 Caleb Johnson: Rollout complete (100%) across prod regions. Collector config patched in us-east-b; region label restored on affected pods. Added label-missing validation panel to rollout SLO dashboard; shared link in #eng-platform. Marking resolved.
resolution:
Implemented canonical metric labeling for api-gateway and serving edge:
- Added route_id (canonical template ID) across all request handlers (chat/embeddings/rerank), avoiding raw-path cardinality.
- Added resolved_model_version label from routing response headers; left request-side model_version intact during dual-write window.
- Fixed otel-collector config in prod/us-east-b to restore region resource attribute mapping.
- Added a validation panel to track % of samples missing required labels per region.

Follow-ups
- ENG-2322 can proceed with monitor labeling migration using route_id + resolved_model_version.
- After 14 days, remove/stop relying on legacy labels in dashboards/alerts (tracked in ENG-2318 / observability cleanup).
